tools.name: list_groups
tools.description: List the saved BlueTab tab groups (name, notes, tab count, dates). Use get_group for the tabs of one group.

tools.name: get_group
tools.description: Get one saved tab group by ID, including every tab title and URL.

tools.name: search_tabs
tools.description: Search saved tabs in every group by title or URL text.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List BlueTab projects and the group IDs each project contains.

tools.name: list_brain_dump
tools.description: List Brain Dump notes (quick thoughts captured in BlueTab) with their page context.

tools.name: get_brain_dump_entry
tools.description: Get one Brain Dump note by ID.

tools.name: save_tab_group
tools.description: Save a new tab group with the given tabs. The change is queued and applied the next time the BlueTab extension is open.

tools.name: update_group
tools.description: Rename a saved group, edit its notes, add tabs or remove tabs by ID. The change is queued and applied the next time the BlueTab extension is open.

tools.name: add_project
tools.description: Create a project, optionally containing existing group IDs. The change is queued and applied the next time the BlueTab extension is open.

tools.name: update_project
tools.description: Rename a project or replace its group list. The change is queued and applied the next time the BlueTab extension is open.

tools.name: add_brain_dump
tools.description: Add a Brain Dump note, optionally linked to a page title and URL. The change is queued and applied the next time the BlueTab extension is open.

tools.name: update_brain_dump
tools.description: Replace the text of a Brain Dump note. The change is queued and applied the next time the BlueTab extension is open.

tools.name: create_reminder
tools.description: Create a reminder that fires at fireAt (Unix time in milliseconds), optionally linked to a group. The change is queued and applied the next time the BlueTab extension is open.
